mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "wordCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s."習得済フラグ") AS "learnedCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s."お気に入りフラグ") AS "favoriteCount", COALESCE(round(avg(s."総合習得度"), 2), 0) AS "averageMastery", COALESCE(sum(s."回答回数"), 0) AS "answeredCount", COALESCE(sum(s."正解回数"), 0) AS "correctCount", COALESCE(sum(s."有効学習時間ms"), 0) AS "activeMs", COALESCE((SELECT d."有効学習時間ms" FROM public."JPN_学習日次情報" d WHERE d."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND d."学習日" = #{today}), 0) AS "todayActiveMs", max(s."最終学習日時") AS "lastStudiedAt" FROM public."JPN_学習状況情報" s WHERE s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId}

SELECT d."学習日" AS "studyDate", d."有効学習時間ms" AS "activeMs", d."A学習時間ms" AS "typeAMs", d."B学習時間ms" AS "typeBMs", d."C学習時間ms" AS "typeCMs", d."D学習時間ms" AS "typeDMs", d."E学習時間ms" AS "typeEMs", d."学習単語数" AS "wordCount", d."完了テスト数" AS "testCount", d."完了課題数" AS "doneCount", d."正解課題数" AS "correctCount", d."不正解課題数" AS "wrongCount" FROM public."JPN_学習日次情報" d WHERE d."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} ORDER BY d."学習日" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: s."単語ID", w."見出し語", w."読み", w."JLPTレベル", w."品詞", col."書籍", col."分類", s."学習状態", s."総合習得度", s."習得済フラグ", s."お気に入りフラグ", s."回答回数", s."正解回数", s."不正解回数", s."連続正解回数", s."最大連続正解回数", s."有効学習時間ms", s."最終テスト種別", s."最終判定", s."初回学習日時", s."最終学習日時", s."次回復習日時", s."復習間隔日数"

FROM public."JPN_学習状況情報" s JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" w ON w."単語ID" = s."単語ID" LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."書籍", c."分類" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" c WHERE c."単語ID" = s."単語ID" ORDER BY c."レベル", c."書籍", c."分類", c."単語SEQ" LIMIT 1 ) col ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public."JPN_技能習得情報" k

SELECT k."単語ID", w."見出し語", w."読み", k."テスト種別", k."技能区分", k."学習状態", k."習得度", k."回答回数", k."正解回数", k."不正解回数", k."連続正解回数", k."最大連続正解回数", k."最終判定", k."最終学習日時", k."次回復習日時" FROM public."JPN_技能習得情報" k JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" w ON w."単語ID" = k."単語ID"
ORDER BY k."最終学習日時" DESC NULLS LAST, k."単語ID" ASC, k."技能区分" LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_学習状況情報" SET "回答回数" = "回答回数" + 1, "正解回数" = "正解回数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "不正解回数" = "不正解回数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "連続正解回数" = CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN "連続正解回数" + 1 ELSE 0 END, "最大連続正解回数" = GREATEST("最大連続正解回数", CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN "連続正解回数" + 1 ELSE "連続正解回数" END), "A確認回数" = "A確認回数" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "有効学習時間ms" = "有効学習時間ms" + #{elapsedMs}, "初回学習日時" = COALESCE("初回学習日時", #{now}), "最終学習日時" = #{now}, "最終テスト種別" = #{testType}, "最終判定" = #{judgment}, "次回復習日時" = #{nextReviewAt}, "復習間隔日数" = #{reviewIntervalDays}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "単語ID" = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_技能習得情報" ( "利用者アカウントID", "単語ID", "テスト種別", "技能区分", "学習状態", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{wordId}, #{testType}, #{skillCode}, 'LEARNING', #{accountId}, 'APP' ) ON CONFLICT ("利用者アカウントID", "単語ID", "テスト種別", "技能区分") DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_技能習得情報" SET "習得度" = #{mastery}, "学習状態" = #{state}, "回答回数" = "回答回数" + 1, "正解回数" = "正解回数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "不正解回数" = "不正解回数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "連続正解回数" = CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN "連続正解回数" + 1 ELSE 0 END, "最大連続正解回数" = GREATEST("最大連続正解回数", CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN "連続正解回数" + 1 ELSE "連続正解回数" END), "最終判定" = #{judgment}, "最終学習日時" = #{now}, "次回復習日時" = #{nextReviewAt}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "単語ID" = #{wordId} AND "テスト種別" = #{testType} AND "技能区分" = #{skillCode}

UPDATE public."JPN_学習状況情報" s SET "総合習得度" = COALESCE(avg_mastery.value, CASE WHEN #{aCheckCount} > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END), "学習状態" = CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg_mastery.value, 0) >= 80 THEN 'MASTERED' WHEN #{judgment} = 'INCORRECT' THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'LEARNING' END, "習得済フラグ" = COALESCE(avg_mastery.value, 0) >= 80, "習得日時" = CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg_mastery.value, 0) >= 80 THEN COALESCE(s."習得日時", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT round(avg(k."習得度"), 2) AS value FROM public."JPN_技能習得情報" k WHERE k."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND k."単語ID" = #{wordId} ) avg_mastery WHERE s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND s."単語ID" = #{wordId}

UPDATE public."JPN_学習状況情報" SET "お気に入りフラグ" = #{favorite}, "お気に入り日時" = CASE WHEN #{favorite} THEN #{now}::timestamp ELSE NULL END, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "単語ID" = #{wordId}

UPDATE public."JPN_学習状況情報" SET "習得済フラグ" = #{learned}, "学習状態" = CASE WHEN #{learned} THEN 'MASTERED' WHEN "学習状態" = 'MASTERED' THEN 'LEARNING' ELSE "学習状態" END, "習得日時" = CASE WHEN #{learned} THEN #{now}::timestamp ELSE NULL END, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "単語ID" = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_学習日次情報" ( "利用者アカウントID", "学習日", "有効学習時間ms", "A学習時間ms", "B学習時間ms", "C学習時間ms", "D学習時間ms", "E学習時間ms", "完了課題数", "正解課題数", "不正解課題数", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{studyDate}, #{elapsedMs}, CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'A' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'B' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'C' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'D' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'E' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, 1, CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, #{accountId}, 'APP' ) ON CONFLICT ("利用者アカウントID", "学習日") DO UPDATE SET "有効学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."有効学習時間ms" + #{elapsedMs}, "A学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."A学習時間ms" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'A' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, "B学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."B学習時間ms" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'B' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, "C学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."C学習時間ms" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'C' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, "D学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."D学習時間ms" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'D' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, "E学習時間ms" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."E学習時間ms" + CASE WHEN #{testType} = 'E' THEN #{elapsedMs} ELSE 0 END, "完了課題数" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."完了課題数" + 1, "正解課題数" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."正解課題数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, "不正解課題数" = public."JPN_学習日次情報"."不正解課題数" + CASE WHEN #{correct} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
